ModMetaData.description:
SexSlaveCraft 2.3.1 (TieJin Modify) 新限制系统与个体行为配置。 基于上游 2.2.8 继续维护，包含 2.3.0 及更早版本内容。 已绑定角色可独立设置主动、被动和调教许可；实际主人向自己的绑定对象发起时，限制系统直接允许。装备与特化统一提供条目强制值。 普通行为、日常调教、仪式、事件及已支持兼容入口使用统一判定，旧档自动迁移。调教页右侧提供勾叉式规则栏，默认配置收纳到设置子窗口。 旧 RimTalk 兼容继续暂停，宠物猫、宠物兔未完成入口继续禁用。 完整中英双语更新记录见 CHANGELOG.md。
Continues development from upstream 2.2.8, including 2.3.0 and earlier content. Adds individual initiation, reception and Training permissions for bound pawns. Their actual owner's initiation is immediately allowed by the restriction system. Equipment and specialization overrides use the same rules. Unifies ordinary jobs, Training, rituals, events and supported compatibility paths, with legacy-save migration. A right-side Training tab panel offers check/cross controls; defaults use a separate settings window. Legacy RimTalk remains suspended; unfinished Pet Cat and Pet Rabbit choices remain disabled. See CHANGELOG.md for the full Chinese and English notes.
